title: Students protest private school building takeover
reason: The reported assembly was a public march by students, but their demand was directed to two private school proprietors over a building takeover and school-year timing, not the Liberian government or state policy. The report says “dozens”; “over 500” refers to students affected, not people assembled, so the >=50 threshold is also unverified.
notes: Police officers blocking school entry are not by themselves evidence that students demanded action from the state. Do not convert school enrollment/affected persons into protest attendance.

title: Jallah Town residents protest electricity shortages and affordability
reason: The reported gathering began on February 8, 2021, outside this January-only unit; record as a separate episode in the February unit rather than a continuation here.
notes: Search snippet reports hundreds and a government/LEC-directed demand, but the source is search-only and remains to be reviewed by the February assignment.
